# xtweetly

> Multi-tenant X (Twitter) automation platform for AI agents. Connect one or more X accounts, then drive them programmatically over MCP or REST: post, reply, like, retweet, quote, follow, bookmark, search, and monitor — all backed by a real browser session, not the X API.

xtweetly speaks two languages:
- **MCP** — drop the server into Claude / Cursor / any MCP client and your agent can act on X with natural-language tool calls.
- **REST** — bearer-authenticated HTTP API (`tk_*` keys) for any agent or backend that prefers raw HTTP.

The same Zod schemas back both surfaces, so a tool name in MCP maps 1:1 to a route in REST.

## Docs

- [Developer overview](https://xtweetly.app/docs): getting started, auth model, action lifecycle, webhook monitors.
- [Connect an X account](https://xtweetly.app/connect): per-client setup guide for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

## API

- [API Reference (Scalar)](https://api.xtweetly.app/docs): interactive reference for all 37 REST endpoints across `auth`, `accounts`, `actions`, `x`, `monitors`, and `admin`.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.xtweetly.app/api/openapi.json): machine-readable JSON; consume with codegen, Postman, Insomnia, or your own tooling.
- Auth: bearer tokens issued from `POST /auth/api-keys`. Format: `Authorization: Bearer tk_...`.
- OAuth resource metadata: `https://api.xtweetly.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`.

## MCP

The MCP server is mounted at `https://api.xtweetly.app/mcp`. It exposes 43 tools backed by the same Zod schemas as the REST API.

### Write tools (queue-backed actions)
- `post_tweet`: Post a tweet from a connected X account.
- `reply_to_tweet`: Reply to a tweet.
- `quote_tweet`: Quote tweet with your own comment.
- `post_thread`: Post a multi-tweet thread (5s spacing between tweets).
- `like_tweet` / `unlike_tweet`: Like or remove a like.
- `retweet_tweet` / `unretweet_tweet`: Retweet or undo a retweet.
- `bookmark_tweet`: Bookmark a tweet.
- `follow_account` / `unfollow_account`: Follow or unfollow an account.
- `delete_tweet`: Delete one of your own tweets.
- `send_dm`: Send a direct message.
- `update_profile`: Update name, bio, location, or website.
- `update_avatar` / `update_banner`: Replace the profile image or banner.

### Read tools (synchronous lookups)

List-style reads return `{ items, nextCursor }`. Pass `nextCursor` back as the `cursor` argument to fetch subsequent pages; cursors are opaque (don't parse them). Single-resource reads (`get_user`, `get_tweet`, `get_x_trending`, `get_thread`) return their plain shape.

- `search_tweets`: Live tweet search by query.
- `search_users`: Search users by name or handle.
- `get_user`: Profile (display name, bio, counts, verified).
- `get_tweet`: Full tweet details by URL.
- `get_user_tweets`: Recent tweets from a user.
- `get_user_followers` / `get_user_following`: Connection lists.
- `get_tweet_retweeters` / `get_tweet_quotes` / `get_tweet_replies`: Engagement on a tweet.
- `get_user_mentions`: Recent tweets mentioning a handle.
- `get_x_trending`: Current X trending topics for the active session region.
- `get_user_likes`: Tweets a user has publicly liked.
- `get_my_bookmarks`: The calling account's own bookmarks.
- `get_list_members`: Members of a public X list (numeric ID).
- `get_mutual_followers`: Followers-you-know — accounts the caller follows that also follow the target.
- `get_thread`: Same-author thread chain rooted at a tweet.
- `get_user_lists`: Lists owned by a user (with name, description, member count).
- `get_list`: List metadata (member + subscriber counts, owner).
- `get_list_subscribers`: Paginated subscribers of a public X list.

### Monitors
- `create_monitor`: Webhook monitor for a target handle.
- `list_monitors` / `get_monitor`: Inspect monitors and recent deliveries.
- `pause_monitor` / `delete_monitor`: Stop polling or remove.

### Bulk extractions (async, file output)

Queue large jobs that run a cursor-paginated read endpoint to completion (up to 100K rows). Output is JSONL on the server; download via REST.

- `create_extraction`: Queue an extraction job (`type` + `params` + `max_rows`). Returns `{id}`.
- `get_extraction`: Poll job status (rows extracted, file path, error).
- `list_extractions`: Recent jobs for the caller.
- `cancel_extraction`: Cancel a queued or running job.

Supported `type` values: `user_followers`, `user_following`, `user_tweets`, `user_likes`, `user_mentions`, `tweet_retweeters`, `search_tweets`, `list_members`. Download endpoint is REST-only: `GET /api/v1/extractions/{id}/download`.

### Accounts, jobs, settings
- `get_accounts` / `get_account_health`: Connected accounts + session health.
- `connect_x_account` / `reauth_x_account` / `get_x_login_job`: Server-side login flow.
- `list_actions` / `cancel_action` / `replay_action`: Manage queued write actions.
- `get_settings` / `update_settings`: Per-account key-value settings.
